caption: This shio ramen features a clear, light broth with delicate menma and shredded cabbage atop tender noodles. Served in a floral-patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under soft, natural light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
The shio (salt) broth is clear golden, holding thin noodles, bean sprouts, and a pink swirl garnish.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
White ceramic bowl with black and green floral patterns, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
